_comment: Compiled from official club honours records and UEFA archives; counts confirmed against published records 11 September 2026. Omitted fields = not confidently verified, never guessed.

arsenal.eu: 1 Cup Winners' Cup (1994) · 1 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup (1970)
arsenal.note: Record 14 FA Cups; beaten European finalists, May 2026

liverpool.eu: 6 European Cups (English record) · 3 UEFA Cups · 4 Super Cups
liverpool.note: Champions 2024–25 — the record 20th title, shared with United

manchester-united.eu: 3 European Cups (1968, 1999, 2008) · 1 Europa League (2017) · 1 Cup Winners' Cup (1991)

chelsea.eu: 2 Champions League (2012, 2021) · 2 Europa League · 2 Cup Winners' Cups · 1 Conference League (2025)

tottenham-hotspur.eu: 3 UEFA Cups/Europa League (1972, 1984, 2025) · 1 Cup Winners' Cup (1963)
tottenham-hotspur.note: The 2025 Europa League — first European trophy since 1984

newcastle-united.note: Waiting since 1955 for the next domestic cup

aston-villa.note: European champions again — the 2026 Europa League bought this season's Champions League place

sunderland.note: The 1973 FA Cup final, won against the odds

crystal-palace.note: The 2025 FA Cup — the club's first major trophy

brentford.note: The 2021 promotion was the first top-flight return since 1947

bournemouth.note: The climb from the brink of extinction to the top flight

hull-city.note: Founded 1904; the top flight arrived for the first time in 2008

coventry-city.note: The 1987 FA Cup final — Spurs beaten 3–2
